Academic project summary. Research materials available on request.

The context

My final-year project explored deep learning for intracranial aneurysm detection and the challenge of explaining a model's predictions.

The approach

  • Co-developed a ResNet-50 classification and U-Net segmentation pipeline.
  • Used Grad-CAM to visualize regions associated with model predictions.
  • Connected model inference to a Flask API and a React review interface.

What came out of it

An academic research prototype spanning model development, explainability, and a web-based review workflow.

Scope & limitations

Academic research only, not a clinically validated diagnostic tool. Performance figures are omitted because the original evaluation report is not available in the supporting portfolio materials.
